post.summary: Sync aMember access for current user
post.description: Pull the calling user's active aMember access records and update their Logto product role assignments immediately. Requires the `roles` user scope. Use this after granting access in aMember so the user does not need to wait for the scheduled inbound sync.

productIds.description: Active aMember product IDs synced to Logto roles.

roleAssignmentsAdded.description: Number of product role assignments added.

roleAssignmentsRemoved.description: Number of product role assignments removed.

401.description: The access token is missing the `roles` scope.

404.description: No matching aMember user was found for this Logto account.

503.description: Inbound aMember sync is not configured or the database connection failed.
